string-array.item: Race two computer cars through five levels. Pick your favourite car colour and take the lead!
Hold the big left and right buttons to steer. Dodge the cones and splash through puddles as little as you can.
Drive over the lightning pads for a burst of speed. Finish in the top 2 to unlock the next level.
The rivals get faster and smarter every level. Collect medals and finish 1st in the last race to become Champion!

string-array.name: about_bodies
string-array.item: Rovatics Racers is a fast, friendly racing game. You race against two computer cars on a track full of cones, puddles and speed boosts. There are five levels, and the rivals get faster and smarter each time.

• 5 levels, from Easy Start to the Champion Cup
• 8 car colours to choose from
• Speed-boost pads, cones and puddles
• Medals, celebrations, sound and haptics (all can be muted)
• Your unlocked levels and best times are saved
• Free, with no ads and no account

1. Pick your car and a level, then tap Start race.
2. Hold the left and right buttons to steer.
3. Dodge the cones, avoid the puddles and drive over the ⚡ pads for a boost.
4. Finish in the top 2 to unlock the next level. Win the last race to become Champion.
• Cones slow you down a lot; puddles slow you a little.\n• You can pause any time, and the game pauses by itself if you leave the app.\n• Small, gentle steering is faster than swerving.
